correctness.rationale: The assignment face of Birkhoff matrices has all diagonal entries zero, row/column sums one, and affine dimension n(n−1)−(2n−1)=n²−3n+1 because the crown bipartite support graph is connected. Uniform off-diagonal center C=(J−I)/(n−1) is interior. Each derangement permutation vertex P has identical squared distance n(n−2)/(n−1) from C. The conjugation module of row/column-zero, diagonal-zero matrices splits into inequivalent real irreducible symmetric partition (n−2,2) of dimension n(n−3)/2 and alternating partition (n−2,1,1) of dimension (n−1)(n−2)/2, for all n≥4. Under each conjugacy class covariance acts scalar on each mode; the symmetric and skew norms depend exactly on the count c2 of 2-cycles. An n-cycle class plus the maximal-transposition derangement class with positive w=(n−3)/d (even) or n/d (odd) has expected c2=n(n−3)/(2d). Thus both covariance blocks have eigenvalue R²/d, and the mean is C by conjugation transitivity. The isotropic contact measure on sphere radius R supplies global unique minimal-volume outer ellipsoid, irrespective of tilted competitors. Strict convexity excludes nonvertex boundary contacts. Independently enumerated the two complete selected conjugacy classes for n=4,5,6 and computed full covariance against the SVD projector on the exact constraint null space, residual <1e−10; the representation-theoretic reasoning provides all-order proof.

originality.rationale: Deranged-matching enumeration, integral matching faces, the Birkhoff polytope and some full-assignment ellipsoids are prior. The claim is the minimum-volume ENCLOSING ball in the distinct zero-diagonal affine hull and an explicit two-class isotropy proof; John inballs or unrestricted full Birkhoff ellipsoids cannot be restricted to infer that shape. No dominating face-specific outer theorem emerged; historical priority remains subject to unindexed restricted-assignment optimal designs.

value.rationale: The crown graph perfect-matching face is a natural, nontrivial and widely studied forbidden-assignment model; exact minimum-volume enclosing geometry differs from the known inscribed John geometry. An explicit positive distribution supported on just two conjugacy classes is a compact, reusable isotropic design for restricted permutation polytopes and a nontrivial alternative to merely observing cospherical vertices.
